# Design musts
Every SageOx surface. Your surface guide adds to these, never against them.

- **DS-000** This palette and type are the brief, on purpose: sage for action, the dust, silt and crater neutrals, Hedvig Letters Serif for display, Inter for UI. A skill may call warm neutrals, a serif display face and near-black text generic defaults to avoid; here they are the brand, so keep them. (DDR-010, DDR-011)
- **DS-001** Color, type, spacing, radius and motion come from design tokens, never a raw hex or a raw palette stop. Sage is the only action hue: one primary action per view, ranked by variant, never by size. (DDR-014, DDR-028)
- **DS-002** Hedvig Letters Serif ships one weight. Never bold it or give it a weight utility. (DDR-016)
- **DS-003** Never color alone: every state and severity pairs its color with a glyph or a word. Text clears 4.5:1 in light and in dark, and a brand color never means warning or danger. (DDR-006, DDR-008)
- **DS-004** Before you build a component, find the existing one in the catalog your surface guide names and import it; never re-implement it, improve the shared one instead. If none exists, build it and register it in that catalog. (no DDR yet)
